messages:
maria: Quick sync — we want to announce the next release (Predictive Routing + batching improvements) the week of Apr 6. Need final changelog, docs links, and an engineered rollout plan by EOD Friday. Can eng and docs confirm?

kevin: On it. I'll paste a changelog draft in a sec. Need to confirm whether the KV cache change is user-visible.

sarah: Docs team can publish a short notice + migration notes. Will need the final API contract and any breaking-change lines. Link to the docs preview URL when ready.

alex: Rolling plan: gradual region rollout (us-west -> eu -> apac) with feature-flagged canary at 10% for 24h. If latency spike > 20% we rollback. Need the model variant IDs and rollback policy in the PR.

kevin: changelog draft: ```
- Feature: Predictive Routing for lower tail latency (enabled by default, opt-out via routing.policy.disablePredictive)
- Improvement: batching pipeline updated to prefer 4-8 token groups for short prompts
- Fix: KV cache eviction edge-case that could cause OOM on long-context streams
- Note: No schema changes to request body; config flags only
```

maria: Nice. Sarah — do you want that trimmed for the blog post? Marketing will craft the narrative and benchmark blurb. We also plan a webinar on Apr 9 — should align messaging with the changelog.

sarah: Yes please. From that changelog: keep the Predictive Routing + lower tail latency part, call out the cost/perf tradeoff and include a short example. I'll need a screenshot of the latency dashboard (token-level breakdown).

liz: Marketing checklist: hero image, benchmark snippet, docs link, webinar CTA, PR contact, and inbound lead routing (SFDC campaign: "Predictive-Routing-Apr2026"). Who owns the SFDC campaign creation?

kevin: ops can create SFDC campaign. @alex can you confirm the lead tagging fields? We need source=web and product=Routing.

alex: Confirmed. Use utm_source=web, utm_campaign=predictive-routing-apr2026, and add a custom field "infra_feature"=predictive_routing. We'll push to the dedicated webhook for inbound leads.

maria: Sarah + Kevin: can you share final docs link + changelog PR by Thursday morning so marketing can draft Monday publish? Also need benchmark numbers (p50/p95 before/after) for the blog.

kevin: I'll open PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/482 — includes the changelog above and a migration note.

sarah: Docs preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/predictive-routing (internal preview) — will add the migration note after Kevin's PR lands.

liz: Webinar ops: host list, slide draft, and registration page. Can marketing get a brief 2-line speaker blurb from eng? @kevin @alex

kevin: I'll send a 2-line blurb and a short benchmark table (p50/p95) to marketing by Thursday. Sample: "Predictive Routing reduces p95 tail latency by ~28% on mixed workloads; typical cost improvement ~12% via smarter batching."

alex: FYI deploy-bot scheduled a deploy window Mon Apr 6 02:00 UTC -> monitoring window 02:00-06:00 UTC. I'll coordinate on-call for that slot.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: service=runtime, env=prod, window=2026-04-06T02:00:00Z/2026-04-06T06:00:00Z, owner=@alex.

maria: OK all — action items: kevin (changelog PR + benchmark numbers) by Thu AM; sarah (docs draft + preview link) by Thu AM; alex (rollout plan + webhook + lead tagging) by Thu EOD; liz (SFDC campaign + webinar page) by Fri AM. I'll assemble the announcement draft once we have links. :tada:

kevin: will do.

sarah: on it.

alex: confirm.

liz: thanks, team :rocket:
